title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal

statement.hi: Binary tree ka `root` diya hai. Uske nodes ki values ka **level order traversal** return karo: level by level, har level me left se right.
statement.en: Given the `root` of a binary tree, return the **level order traversal** of its nodes’ values: level by level, left to right within each level.

hi: Har level shuru hone pe queue ka size note karo — utne hi nodes is level ke hain.
en: At the start of each level, note the queue size — exactly that many nodes belong to this level.

approach.hi:
BFS with queue: jab tak queue khaali nahi, uska current size `sz` lo, `sz` nodes pop karke unki values ek level me daalo aur unke children push karo.
Har node ek baar: O(n) time, O(width) space.
approach.en:
BFS with a queue: while it is not empty, take its current size `sz`, pop `sz` nodes into one level and push their children.
Each node once: O(n) time, O(width) space.
